body:
User asked (verbatim, via lead r11-oauth brief):
  Build these six (owner decisions 2026-10-05/06): 1. Logout provider choice as a parameter (general logout route taking provider, same code path and returnTo validation). 2. Provider display names: DisplayName on providers + GET /auth/oauth/providers. 3. Discovery fallback: static endpoints used ONLY when discovery is unreachable; logged. 4. oauth.SkipBrokenProviders() opt-in. 5. OAuth2.GetToken hook replacing the code exchange. 6. oauth.AllowProviderInitiated() per-provider opt-in for IdP-initiated sign-in (OIDC only, ID token fully verified, never auto-linked, fresh sign-in, risk documented).

Context:
  Files: plugin/oauth/*, docs/plugins/oauth.md, the tokens checklist, providers.md
Acceptance:
  Unit tests per new function/behaviour, integration on SQLite/Postgres/MySQL where DB involved, each proven by breaking; checklist rows updated with owner markers; task check, staticcheck, task cover green.
title: oauth: six owner-decided feature builds (logout provider param, display names, discovery fallback, SkipBrokenProviders, GetToken, AllowProviderInitiated)
